questions.text: How many rings feature in the Olympic symbol?
questions.explanation: The five interlocking rings represent the continents.

questions.text: In motor racing, which flag signals the end of a race?
questions.explanation: The chequered flag is waved at the finish.

questions.text: Which city hosted the 2012 Summer Olympics?
In which country did the ancient Olympic Games take place?
questions.explanation: They were held at Olympia in Greece.

questions.text: Which French city gives its name to a famous 24-hour sports car race?
questions.explanation: The 24 Hours of Le Mans began in 1923.

questions.text: Which city hosted the 1964 Summer Olympics, the first held in Asia?
questions.explanation: Tokyo staged the 1964 Games, the first Olympics in Asia.

questions.text: Which Brazilian won Formula One world titles in 1988, 1990 and 1991?
questions.explanation: Senna won three titles with McLaren.

questions.text: Where were the first modern Olympic Games held in 1896?
questions.explanation: The first modern Games took place in Athens.

questions.text: Who won the men's 100m gold at the 2008 Beijing Olympics?
questions.explanation: Bolt won in a then world record 9.69 seconds.

questions.text: Which US swimmer won eight gold medals at the 2008 Games?
questions.explanation: Phelps won eight golds in Beijing.

questions.text: Which city hosted the 1956 Olympics, the first Games held in the Southern Hemisphere?
Who was the first Formula One World Champion in 1950?
questions.explanation: Farina won the inaugural 1950 title for Alfa Romeo.

questions.text: Which Romanian gymnast scored the first perfect 10 at the Olympics in 1976?
questions.explanation: Comaneci scored a perfect 10 on the uneven bars in Montreal.

questions.text: Which Finnish runner, the Flying Finn, won nine Olympic golds in the 1920s?
questions.explanation: Nurmi won nine golds between 1920 and 1928.

questions.text: Which circuit is nicknamed the Green Hell?
questions.explanation: Jackie Stewart nicknamed the Nordschleife the Green Hell.

spares.text: What colour medal goes to the Olympic runner-up?
spares.explanation: Silver is awarded for second place.

spares.text: Which city hosted the 2000 Summer Olympics?
Which British athlete won heptathlon gold at the London 2012 Olympics?
spares.explanation: Ennis won heptathlon gold on the night dubbed Super Saturday at London 2012.
